hints: Blocked edges need no special handling in the algorithm. Read them and delete them from the weight matrix; after that it is ordinary Prim.
Print a snapshot at the moment a vertex joins the tree with a real edge - that is, when you mark u done and parent[u] != -1. The source itself joins with no edge and prints nothing.
Blocking can disconnect the graph, and then the answer is -1 alone. Run Prim once silently to check, then again to print.
source: Reconstruction of the DSA Lab Week 5 modification question
title: Prim with blocked edges, printing every step
